post.caption: The Juicy Salif's gold twin dreads lemons. Philippe Starck designed this lemon squeezer for Alessi in 1990. He sketched it on a placemat while squeezing lemon over fried squid. It is cast aluminum, 29 centimeters tall, on three legs. Starck said it was made to start conversations. Copies are kept in the Met and the V&A. For its tenth anniversary in 2000, Alessi made a gold-plated edition. Citric acid would discolor and erode the plating. Its instructions say never to use it with real fruit.
